G2 Esports (formerly known as Gamers2) is a German professional esports organization, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, and founded in November 2013 by Carlos "ocelote" Rodriguez.

  • February 11th - Gamers2 sign the ex-ESC Gaming roster consisting of innocent, SZPERO, mouz, rallen, and MINISE. [1]
  • April 9th - MINISE is replaced by MICHU. [2]
  • April 22nd - rallen is replaced by MINISE. [3]
  • May 1st - dArk joins in as a coach. [4]
  • July 9th - Loord replaces dArk as coach. [5]
  • August 3rd - Gamers2 part ways with their CS:GO squad. [6]
  • September 11th - Gamers2 sign the former Team Kinguin roster, consisting of ScreaM, rain, Maikelele, fox, and dennis. [7]
  • September 23rd - ScreaM is acquired by Titan. [8]
  • September 30th - jkaem joins Gamers2 from Copenhagen Wolves. [9]
  • October 14th - Gamers2 part ways with their coach LEGIJA. [10]
  • October 15th - Gamers2 rebrand to G2 Esports. [11]
  • November 12th - G2 Esports acquires aizy after the departure of dennis to Fnatic, both for undisclosed transfer fees. [12][13]
  • January 20th - G2 Esports' roster is acquired by FaZe Clan for a reported amount of $700,000. [14][15]
  • February 1st - G2 Esports sign the former roster of Titan. [16]
  • April 9th - bodyy replaces Ex6TenZ. [17]
  • February 3rd - G2 Esports announce a new roster, consisting of shox and bodyy from the previous roster, with NBK-, apEX, and kennyS from Team EnVyUs. SmithZz steps down to coach, with enkay J, moving from EnVyUs to join as head analyst. RpK and ScreaM leave the team. [18]
  • March 9th - G2 Esports announce the addition of mixwell, who will be replacing shox on trial starting after his run in WESG 2017. SmithZz also steps down as coach, after expressing his desire to return to playing, resulting in manager NiaK taking over. Both SmithZz and shox move to the bench. [19]
  • May 28th - G2 Esports announce that mixwell is allowed to explore other options. [20]
  • June 4th - shox and SmithZz return to the active roster, Ex6TenZ joins as a stand-in, NBK- and apEX are benched. [21]
  • June 25th - enkay J steps down to look for new opportunities. [22]
  • September 25th - The contract of enkay J expires. [23]
  • October 8th - NBK- and apEX are acquired by Team Vitality. [24][25]
  • November 26th - G2 Esports replace SmithZz and Ex6TenZ with Lucky and JaCkz from 3DMAX, maLeK joins as a full-time coach and shox becomes the in-game leader. [26]
  • February 21st - G2 Esports release Ex6TenZ. [27]
  • March 7th - G2 Esports bench bodyy and bring in AMANEK to replace him. [28]
  • June 19th - bodyy's contract expires and he leaves G2 Esports. [29]
  • August 15th - Swani joins G2 Esports as an analyst. [30]
  • September 26th - G2 Esports part ways with shox. [31]
  • September 30th - G2 Esports acquire nexa and huNter- from CR4ZY. Lucky is benched. [32]
  • October 8th - Lucky is acquired by Team Heretics. [33]
  • February 3rd - G2 Esports release SmithZz upon his retirement from Counter-Strike: Global Offensive. [34]
  • February 13th - Evy joins G2 Esports as their assistant coach. [35][36]
  • June 13th - G2 Esports part ways with Evy. [37]
  • October 28th - G2 Esports acquire NiKo from FaZe Clan. [38]
  • December 7th - G2 Esports bench JACKZ. [39]
  • March 4th - G2 Esports bench kennyS and reinstate JACKZ to the active roster. [40]
  • November 16th - G2 Esports part ways with maLeK; Swani steps in as interim coach. [41][42]
  • January 1st - G2 Esports move Swani to an assistant coach position. [43]
  • January 3rd - G2 Esports acquire m0NESY from Natus Vincere Junior. [44]
  • January 23rd - G2 Esports and OG exchange nexa and Aleksib. Additionally, G2 Esports bench AMANEK and sign XTQZZZ as their new head coach. [45]
  • May 7th - huNter- and NiKo sign a multi-year contract extension with G2 Esports. [46]
  • June 29th - G2 Esports hire peca as their European esports manager. [47]
  • July 22nd - AMANEK is acquired by Team LDLC. [48]
  • August 10th - JACKZ is acquired by HEET. [49]
  • August 16th - G2 Esports bench Aleksib and acquire jks and HooXi from Complexity Gaming and Copenhagen Flames, respectively. [50]
  • September 8th - Aleksib is acquired by Ninjas in Pyjamas. [51]
  • October 29th - G2 Esports part ways with XTQZZZ while Swani takes over as interim coach. [52][53]
  • November 1st - G2 Esports part ways with NiaK while peca takes over as general manager of the Counter-Strike: Global Offensive division. [54][55]
  • November 15th - kennyS is acquired by Team Falcons. [56][57]
  • January 20th - Swani assumes the coaching role on a permanent basis. [58]
  • November 21st - G2 Esports bench jks and acquire nexa from OG as his replacement. [59][60]
  • December 11th - G2 Esports sign TaZ as the team's new head coach. [61]
  • December 16th - G2 Esports part ways with Swani. [62]
  • January 15th - G2 Esports sign sunlight as an analyst. [63]

  • July 9th - G2 Esports sign Aymeinstein as an assistant coach. [71]

  • June 3rd - HeavyGod signs a multi-year contract extension with G2 Esports. [87]
